    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">工控生态之数据与业务：采集到的数据怎么存、怎么管、怎么用</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 data-layout-id="0"><span>前言</span></h1>
<p><span>大家好，我是wacky。上一篇我们聊了通信协议——Modbus和OPC UA怎么选、怎么用、怎么避坑。如果通信协议是"把数据搬过来"，那今天这一篇解决的问题是：数据搬过来之后怎么办。</span></p>
<p><span>一个工控上位机系统，通信只是第一步。PLC每秒推送几百上千个数据点，你拿到了温度、压力、流量、位置……然后呢？直接显示在界面上？关掉程序就没了。写进文本文件？查询的时候痛苦不堪。更别提那些复杂的业务逻辑——设备运行到什么阶段了、什么时候该报警、报警之后走什么流程——这些都不是通信层能解决的。</span></p>
<p><span>这一篇我们聊三件事：数据怎么存、数据怎么访问、业务逻辑怎么设计。对应.NET工控技术栈的第二层——数据与业务层。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="4"><span>数据存储：先分清两类数据</span></h1>
<p><span>工控场景的数据分两类，存储策略完全不同。</span></p>
<p><span>第一类是配置数据和业务数据——设备信息、用户权限、工单记录、报警历史。这类数据的特点是结构化、需要事务支持、查询条件复杂、数据量可控。说白了就是关系型数据库的活儿。</span></p>
<p><span>第二类是时序数据——传感器采集的温度曲线、电机转速波动、压力趋势。这类数据的特点是写入频繁（每秒成百上千条）、单条数据简单、按时间范围查询、很少修改。这是时序数据库的主场。</span></p>
<p><span>两类数据用不同的存储方案，别图省事用一个数据库搞定所有事。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="9"><span>SQLite：工控上位机的默认选择</span></h1>
<p><span>配置数据和业务数据，首选必须是SQLite。</span></p>
<p><span>原因很实在：工控上位机通常部署在工业PC或触摸屏上，不一定有数据库服务器，也不一定有DBA维护。SQLite是嵌入式数据库，不需要安装服务、不需要配置账号密码、一个文件就是整个数据库，跟着你的程序走。对于大多数单机上位机项目，SQLite完全够用。</span></p>
<p><span>EFCore配合SQLite，NuGet安装Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite，定义好实体类和DbContext就能跑：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 报警记录实体</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AlarmRecord
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DateTime Timestamp { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> DeviceName { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设备名称</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> AlarmCode { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 报警代码</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Description { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 报警描述</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> AlarmLevel Level { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 报警等级</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsAcknowledged { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 是否已确认</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AlarmLevel
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; }            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Info / Warning / Critical</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> DbContext</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AppDbContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;AlarmRecord&gt; Alarms { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;AlarmLevel&gt; AlarmLevels { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder options) =&gt; options.UseSqlite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data Source=control.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>写入一条报警记录就这么直接：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> db = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AppDbContext();

db.Alarms.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AlarmRecord
{
    Timestamp </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.Now,
    DeviceName </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EVO500-主轴电机</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AlarmCode </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TEMP_OVER</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    Description </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">主轴温度超过80℃</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    Level </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AlarmLevel
    {
        Id </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Critical</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    },
    IsAcknowledged </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
});

db.SaveChanges();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>SQLite有一个工控场景下特别重要的特性：WAL模式（Write-Ahead Logging）。默认模式下，写入会锁住整个数据库，读操作被阻塞。开启WAL后读写可以并发，不会因为正在写入历史数据导致界面查询卡顿。一行配置搞定：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据库初始化后执行：PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder options) =&gt; options.UseSqlite(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data Source=control.db;Mode=ReadWriteCreate</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h1 data-layout-id="18"><span>EF Core还是Dapper</span></h1>
<p><span>这是个绕不开的问题。EF Core和Dapper都能做数据访问，选哪个？</span></p>
<p><span>EF Core的优势是开发效率高——实体类定义好，迁移自动生成表结构，LINQ写查询不用拼SQL。对于配置数据、业务数据这种CRUD为主的场景，EF Core很合适。</span></p>
<p><span>Dapper的优势是性能高、轻量——它是微型ORM，直接写SQL，映射到对象。对于高频写入的报警记录、批量插入操作日志，Dapper比EF Core快几倍。</span></p>
<p><span>我的做法是混用。业务数据的增删改查用EF Core，高频写入和复杂查询用Dapper。两者可以共享同一个数据库连接，互不冲突。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> EF Core：查询未确认的报警列表</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> db = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AppDbContext();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> activeAlarms =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> db.Alarms
  .Where(a </span>=&gt; !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">a.IsAcknowledged)
  .OrderByDescending(a </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> a.Timestamp)
  .ToList();


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Dapper：批量插入采集日志</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> conn = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> SqliteConnection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data Source=control.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> logBatch = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[]
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Timestamp = DateTime.Now, TagName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Temperature</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Value = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25.6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Timestamp = DateTime.Now, TagName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Pressure</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Value = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">101.3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Timestamp = DateTime.Now, TagName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Humidity</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Value = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60.2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
};
conn.Execute(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">INSERT INTO CollectionLogs (Timestamp, TagName, Value) VALUES (@Timestamp, @TagName, @Value)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, logBatch);</pre>
</div>
<h1 data-layout-id="24"><span>InfluxDB：时序数据的正确打开方式</span></h1>
<p><span>说回第二类数据——时序数据。如果你只是存几百个标签位、保留几天，SQLite也能凑合。但一旦数据量大起来——几十个PLC、每个PLC上百个变量、每秒采一次、要保留半年——SQLite就扛不住了。查询一条温度曲线，从几百万行里筛选时间范围，SQLite会让你等到怀疑人生。</span></p>
<p><span>这时候就该上时序数据库了。InfluxDB是.NET工控圈用得比较多的方案，专为时序数据设计。它的数据模型和关系型数据库完全不同——不按行存储，按时间序列存储，写入和范围查询都极快。</span></p>
<p><span>.NET中可以使用InfluxDB.Client库，写入一段温度采集数据：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> client = InfluxDBClientFactory.Create(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://localhost:8086</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">your-token</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 写入一条温度数据点</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> point = PointData.Measurement(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">temperature</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Tag(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">device</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EVO500</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Tag(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">location</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">车间A-工位3</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Field(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">value</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">76.5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Timestamp(DateTime.UtcNow, WritePrecision.Ms);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> writeApi =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.GetWriteApi();
writeApi.WritePoint(point, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">industrial</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">org</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 查询最近一小时的温度趋势</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> flux = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
        from(bucket: ""industrial"")
            |&gt; range(start: -1h)
            |&gt; filter(fn: (r) =&gt; r._measurement == ""temperature"" and r.device == ""EVO500"")
            |&gt; aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queryApi =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> client.GetQueryApi();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> tables = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> queryApi.QueryAsync(flux, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">org</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> table <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tables)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> record <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> table.Records)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{record.GetTime():HH:mm} -&gt; {record.GetValue()}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span>这段代码做的事是：从InfluxDB中查询EVO500设备最近1小时的温度数据，按1分钟窗口取平均值。在界面上画成曲线，就是一条平滑的趋势图。</span></p>
<p><span>时序数据的存储策略有个要点：热数据存InfluxDB，冷数据归档。比如最近3个月的数据放在InfluxDB里供实时查询，超过3个月的自动导出到Parquet文件或压缩归档。别让时序库无限膨胀，否则内存和磁盘都吃不消。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="31"><span>Stateless：设备状态机没那么难</span></h1>
<p><span><span>数据存好了，接下来是业务逻辑。工控场景中最常见的业务逻辑是状态管理——设备现在是什么状态、什么条件触发状态切换、切换时执行什么动作。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>很多人一开始用一堆if-else和bool变量来管理状态，设备少的时候能跑，设备一多就变成意大利面条——状态转换逻辑散落在各处，改一个地方怕影响全局，调试的时候根本理不清"设备怎么走到这个异常状态的"。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>正确的做法是用状态机。.NET生态里Stateless是最轻量的状态机库，NuGet一键安装，定义状态和转换规则后，状态流转由库托管，你的代码只需要关注业务动作。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>以汇川EVO系列PLC控制的加热设备为例，定义四个状态：待机、加热中、保温中、故障：</span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 状态机配置</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> machine = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> StateMachine&lt;DeviceState, DeviceTrigger&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(DeviceState.Idle);

machine.Configure(DeviceState.Idle)
    .Permit(DeviceTrigger.StartHeat, DeviceState.Heating)
    .Ignore(DeviceTrigger.ReachTarget);

machine.Configure(DeviceState.Heating)
    .OnEntry(() </span>=&gt; Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">启动加热器，开始升温</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    .Permit(DeviceTrigger.ReachTarget, DeviceState.Holding)
    .Permit(DeviceTrigger.FaultOccurred, DeviceState.Fault);

machine.Configure(DeviceState.Holding)
    .OnEntry(() </span>=&gt; Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">到达目标温度，切换保温模式</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    .Permit(DeviceTrigger.Stop, DeviceState.Idle)
    .Permit(DeviceTrigger.FaultOccurred, DeviceState.Fault);

machine.Configure(DeviceState.Fault)
    .OnEntry(() </span>=&gt; Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">设备故障！触发报警，切断加热器</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    .Permit(DeviceTrigger.Reset, DeviceState.Idle);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>状态机的使用非常直观——收到事件时调用Fire触发转换，Stateless会自动检查当前状态是否允许该转换：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> currentTemp = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从PLC读到温度到达目标值</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (currentTemp &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">80</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    machine.Fire(DeviceTrigger.ReachTarget);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前是Heating状态 → 自动切换到Holding，同时触发OnEntry里的"切换保温模式"</span>


<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> plcFaultSignal = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">发生故障</span>
plcFaultSignal = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> PLC上报故障信号</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (plcFaultSignal)
{
    machine.Fire(DeviceTrigger.FaultOccurred);
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 无论当前什么状态（只要不是Fault）→ 切换到Fault，触发报警逻辑</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Stateless最大的价值不是少写了几行if-else，而是把状态转换规则集中在一个地方定义，看得见、改得动、测得了。新人接手项目，看一眼状态机配置就能理解设备的行为逻辑，不用满代码库翻找"这个状态是在哪儿切换的"。</p>
<h1 data-layout-id="40"><span>Elsa：当业务流程复杂到状态机扛不住</span></h1>
<p><span>Stateless适合单设备的状态管理。但有些工控场景的流程更复杂——不只是一个设备的状态，而是跨设备、跨系统、有审批节点的业务流程。比如：报警触发后，先通知值班工程师→15分钟未确认则升级通知车间主管→主管确认后生成维修工单→工单完成后设备复位。这种多步骤、有条件分支、有超时升级的流程，用状态机写会很别扭，用if-else更是灾难。</span></p>
<p><span>这时候可以考虑工作流引擎。.NET生态里Elsa是比较活跃的工作流框架，支持可视化设计流程、持久化流程状态、超时和事件触发。不过说实话，Elsa在工控领域的应用还不算普及，大多数项目用Stateless + 简单的定时器就能覆盖。Elsa更适合那些业务流程复杂到需要"流程图"来管理的场景。</span></p>
<p><span>这一层只先点到为止，实际项目中你会发现——80%的业务逻辑用Stateless就够了，Elsa还是太庞大了。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="44"><span>三层架构怎么落地</span></h1>
<p><span>把前面聊的串起来，一个典型的.NET工控上位机数据与业务层架构是这样的：</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/443744/202608/443744-20260804210219250-520286737.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span>最底层是数据访问层——EF Core管配置数据和业务数据的CRUD，Dapper管高频写入和复杂查询，InfluxDB管时序数据。三个各司其职，互不越界。</span></p>
<p><span>中间层是业务逻辑层——Stateless管理设备状态机，报警引擎判断阈值和升级规则，定时任务做数据归档和报表生成。</span></p>
<p><span>最上面是服务层——把业务逻辑封装成接口，供展示层调用。展示层不需要知道数据存在哪、状态机怎么转，只管调接口拿结果。</span></p>
<p><span>这个分层不是教条，而是实战经验。我见过太多上位机项目把通信、存储、业务逻辑、界面全搅在一起，前期开发快，后期改一个功能牵一发动全身。分层的好处是每一层可以独立测试、独立替换——换通信协议不影响业务逻辑，换数据库不影响界面，换界面框架不影响数据层。</span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="51"><span>后记</span></h1>
<p><span>数据与业务层是工控上位机的"中场"——它承接通信层搬来的数据，支撑展示层的所有交互。这一层做不好，界面再漂亮也是空中楼阁；这一层做扎实了，上面换什么界面框架都从容。</span></p>
<p><span>目前三篇工控生态地图到这里就完整了：第一篇概览全局，第二篇讲通信协议，第三篇讲数据与业务。下一篇我们进入展示层——界面框架怎么选、可视化控件怎么用、怎么让工业软件告别"土味"。敬请期待！</span><span><span><br></span></span></p>
<p><span>本文首发于我的公众号【wacky的碎碎念】，欢迎关注追更！</span></p>
